status.main_product: Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (drones) and mapping software/services
status.scope_reason: The company explicitly designs, manufactures, and sells survey-grade mapping drones (e.g., RYNO, Q6 V2 GEO) and delivers Drone-as-a-Service (DaaS) mapping projects under its own name.
status.evidence: ideaForge Technology Limited is actively trading on the BSE/NSE and recently secured an official drone supply order from the Survey of India for its DGCA-certified Q6 V2 mapping drones in October 2026.

claims.claim: The company reports that its specialized mapping platforms, including the Q6 V2 GEO and NETRA V4 PRO, feature a multi-payload swappable system that integrates photogrammetry, oblique imaging, hyperspectral sensors, and colorized LiDAR modules.
claims.source: ideaForge Q6 V2 GEO product documentation and promotional videos confirming swappable payloads including photogrammetry, oblique imaging, hyperspectral, and colorized LiDAR.

claims.claim: The company reports that its UAV systems integrate with Inertial Labs LiDAR payloads and proprietary PPK modules to deliver survey-grade accuracy, supported by its custom flight planning software, BlueFire Touch, which can dynamically adjust flight speed down to 5 m/s to optimize point-cloud density.
claims.source: Inertial Labs official partnership press release (July 2024) and ideaForge Q6 V2 GEO brochure confirming integration with Inertial Labs LiDAR payloads and BlueFire Touch flight planning capability to dynamically adjust flight speed down to 5 m/s.

claims.claim: The company reports that its drones natively integrate with industry-leading photogrammetric imaging systems and third-party mapping software while being fully optimized for post-processing and workflow integration via FLYGHT CLOUD.
claims.source: ideaForge FLYGHT CLOUD official documentation outlining its hardware-agnostic platform architecture, third-party mapping software integration, and data processing workflows.

claims.claim: The company reports that its RYNO survey-grade micro UAV delivers centimetre-level accuracy, with real-world typical X, Y accuracy of less than 5 cm at 60 meters above ground level (AGL) and typical Z accuracy of less than 10 cm at 60 meters AGL.
claims.source: ideaForge RYNO UAV launch press release and official specifications confirming real-world typical X,Y accuracy of <5 cm and typical Z accuracy of <10 cm at 60 meters AGL.

claims.claim: The Survey of India (SOI) independently validated and qualified the company's survey-grade micro drones for large-scale rural mapping under the SVAMITVA Yojana project, and subsequently placed an order in October 2026 for its Q6 V2 UAVs to collect high-quality aerial geospatial data.
claims.corrected: The Survey of India (SOI) independently validated and qualified the company's survey-grade micro drones for large-scale rural mapping under the SVAMITVA Yojana project, and subsequently placed an order in October 2026 for its Q6 V2 UAVs to collect high-quality aerial geospatial data.
claims.note: The original sentence is completely factual based on published corporate updates from October 13, 2026, which report that the Survey of India ordered the Q6 V2 UAVs following previous large-scale deployments under the SVAMITVA Yojana.
claims.source: Survey of India order announcements and official press reports dated October 13, 2026.

claims.claim: The company reports that its small category quadcopter, the Q6, has an endurance of 60 minutes with a daylight payload and 50 minutes with a 20 MP photogrammetry mapping payload.
The company reports that its NAKSH payload line offers a LiDAR system developed in integration with Inertial Labs, as well as a 16 MP multispectral 4-band camera and 24.3 MP photogrammetry sensors.
claims.note: The combination of specific camera specifications (16 MP multispectral 4-band camera, 24.3 MP photogrammetry sensors) being part of the NAKSH payload line could not be confirmed in available product literature.

claims.parameter: R&D and Innovation in Surveying Tech
claims.claim: The company reports investing 22% of its revenues into research and development during FY24, with planned higher R&D spend allocated for developing proprietary UAV technology and product platforms.

claims.parameter: R&D and Innovation in Surveying Tech
claims.claim: The company reports a technology pipeline featuring over 100 patent filings and 52 granted patents as of June 2026, alongside its custom FlyghtCloud analytics software platform which integrates AI-based anomaly detection for surveying operations.
claims.corrected: The company reports a technology pipeline featuring over 100 patent filings and 52 granted patents as of January 2026, alongside its custom FlyghtCloud analytics software platform which integrates AI-based anomaly detection for surveying operations.

claims.claim: IdeaForge Technology Limited announced it secured an order on October 13, 2026, from the Survey of India for its DGCA-certified Q6 V2 unmanned aerial vehicles to support large-scale geospatial surveying and mapping.
claims.corrected: IdeaForge Technology Limited announced it secured an order on October 13, 2026, from the Survey of India for its DGCA-certified Q6 V2 unmanned aerial vehicles to support large-scale geospatial surveying and mapping.

claims.claim: The company reports implementing a Drone-as-a-service mapping project using its Q6 V2 UAV platform for the Delhi State Industrial and Infrastructure Development Corporation (DSIIDC) to digitize 675 acres of industrial land records.

The company reports that for the third quarter of FY26 ending December 2025, the sale of unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) was the sole source of its operational revenue, yielding ₹31.5 crore out of its ₹34 crore total revenue.
claims.corrected: The company reports that for the third quarter of FY26 ending December 2025, the sale of unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) was the sole source of its operational revenue, yielding ₹31.6 crore out of its ₹34.2 crore total revenue.
claims.source: ideaForge Q3 FY26 Financial Results filings and press updates

claims.claim: The company reports in its FY24 segment breakdown that its primary revenue segment is Unmanned Aerial Vehicles, generating ₹210 crore out of ₹226 crore in total revenue, while civil use cases overall contributed 21% of FY24 revenue.
claims.corrected: The company reports in its FY24 segment breakdown that its primary revenue segment is Unmanned Aerial Vehicles, generating ₹314 crore out of ₹314 crore in total revenue, while civil use cases overall contributed 21% of FY24 revenue.
claims.source: ideaForge Q4 FY24 Investor Presentation and Annual Report 2023-24

claims.claim: The company announced in October 2026 that it secured an order from the Survey of India to supply its DGCA-certified Q6 V2 survey drones to support large-scale topographic mapping and surveying requirements across diverse terrains.
claims.source: ideaForge Press Release / Stock Exchange filings (October 2026)

claims.claim: In July 2024, ideaForge Technology Limited announced a partnership with Inertial Labs to integrate the latter's RESEPI LiDAR solution into ideaForge's high-performance NETRA and Q6 class UAVs to jointly offer precision 3D mapping and surveying solutions across mining, forestry, GIS, and land surveys.
claims.source: Inertial Labs and ideaForge Official Partnership Press Release (July 2024)

claims.claim: In 2022, the company established national distribution agreements with Savex Technologies, PV Lumens LLP, and Ingram Micro India to distribute its UAV platforms and expand its value-added reseller and system integrator channel network across India.
claims.source: ideaForge Technology Limited Red Herring Prospectus (2023) filed with BSE India

claims.claim: The company reports in its FY 2023–24 annual report that it holds a ~50% market share in the Indian unmanned aircraft systems (UAS) space, with its manufactured drones completing over 100,000 successful customer flights during the fiscal year.
claims.corrected: The company reports in its FY 2023–24 annual report that it holds a ~50% market share in the Indian unmanned aircraft systems (UAS) space, with its manufactured drones completing over 450,000 successful customer flights.
claims.source: ideaForge Technology Limited FY 2023-24 Annual Report

claims.claim: The company reports that its indigenous UAV fleet crossed a cumulative total of 1 million customer flights during the first quarter ended June 30, 2026, with an ideaForge drone taking off every 2 minutes on average for surveillance and mapping.
claims.source: ideaForge Technology Limited Q1 FY27 Audited Financial Results Media Brief and Earnings Transcript

claims.claim: The company reports executing a 220 km corridor survey at 2 cm GSD using a 4-drone crew for the National Highways Authority of India and a 480-hectare iron-ore stockpile volumetric audit with 3 cm vertical accuracy in Odisha.
The company reports capabilities in aerial intelligence data processing, listing deliverables such as orthomosaics, point clouds, DSM/DTM/DEM, CAD files, GIS layers, and 3D models.
claims.note: The exact list of processing deliverables (orthomosaics, point clouds, DSM/DTM/DEM, CAD files, GIS layers, 3D models) could not be entirely confirmed in the available company materials.
